description.value: Clinical, structural MRI, and [18F]AV1451 PET findings were examined in a V337M MAPT mutation carrier with behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia, with neuropathologic comparison to affected carriers.

description.value: The study included a symptomatic proband and cognitively normal controls for neuroimaging, with neuropathologic examination of affected family members and an unrelated carrier.
